_doc: Hub and landmark site prefabs on the walkable globe (SiteBuilders; built by the definition's sites_script). sites: [{id, kind (hub | landmark), name, size_m (pad diameter), clear_core_m (junk-free core, default 12), start_only (true: only hub 0 gets it; the other hubs cycle through the rest), desc}], hubs first. Optional: hub_pad_m (flat pad radius of hubs after the first, default 82), fill_pad (the builder gets the pad's flat radius as opts.flat), yard_keep_out (the start yard keeps junk off its pad piece by piece), api (a note on the script's entry point).
api: [p_seas] Placeable hub-site prefabs (planets/rime/rime_site.gd): RimeHubSite.place(id, root, stage 0-2, restoration 0-1, {radius, seed}); a local ice patch about 80-90 m across (walkable trimesh, PROP colliders on every structure). Preview: res://planets/rime/site_preview.tscn -- --site=<id>.

sites.name: Drill Camp
sites.desc: Cabins on skids round a plated yard, a greenhouse dome, fuel tanks, a comms mast and a snowcat.

sites.name: Frozen Derrick
sites.desc: A Ledger core-drill derrick frozen into the ice; a geothermal tap when restored.

sites.name: The Borehole
sites.desc: The shaft under its headframe and winder house; cold mist, then a warm glow.

sites.name: Hot Springs
sites.desc: Geothermal pools with a bathhouse and boardwalk; frozen, then steaming.
